> [!CAUTION]
> **PLEASE DO NOT SUBMIT SECURITY VULNERABILITIES VIA PUBLIC GITHUB ISSUES.**
>
> Public vulnerability reports put active users and assets at risk.

If you have discovered a potential security vulnerability or exploit in Mallaka:

1. Refer to our [Security Policy (SECURITY.md)](../../SECURITY.md).
2. Email full reproduction steps and details confidentially to:
   **`security@example.com`** *(placeholder for project security team)*
3. We will acknowledge receipt within **72 hours** and coordinate a fix and disclosure timeline with you.

Thank you for helping keep our riders and lessors safe!
